title: Termwise comparison after cartesian flat base change
statement: Let f:X\to S and p:Y\to W be quasi-compact quasi-separated morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], where W is an open of a scheme T. Let U be an open of S and V an open of U. Let M be a quasi-coherent module on Y flat over p [pqf-def-coherent, def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], and F any module on X. Suppose g:V\to W and q:X\times_S V\to Y form a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product], and q^*M is isomorphic to the restriction of F [def-pc-module-pullback]. Supply independent derived localizations on X,S,T,Y,W,U and all localized sites of U [def-pc-derived-category]. Let L be additive and isomorphic to tensor pullback along V\to W\to T followed by the inverse localized-site equivalence. For every bounded-above finite-free complex P on T whose exact restriction to W represents Rp_*M[0] [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], the exact localized restriction to V of (Rf_*F[0])|_U is isomorphic to Q(L(P)), with L acting termwise. No Noetherian model or coherent source is asserted or required.

proof.text: Use open direct-image restriction for f on V	o U	o S. The given sheaf isomorphism replaces the restricted F by q^*M in the pullback source.

Apply relatively flat tensor base change to p, the perfect unit and the single complex M[0]. The cartesian square gives the comparison between the resulting image and Lg^*Rp_*M[0]; compose with the given representative isomorphism.

Finite-free terms are flat and the bounded-above complex is K-flat. Compute derived pullback termwise, compose ordinary pullbacks along g and W inclusion, and transport through the exact localized-site equivalence. Localization uniqueness compares independent universes and a common K-injective resolution compares direct-image constructions. Compose these isomorphisms.
